text:
emma: Heads-up — noticed the new starter kit for modular agents (Next + LangChain adapters) is failing telemetry and auth in a specific flow. Anyone else hitting this?
raj: Seeing it locally. Steps: clone, yarn, next dev, create agent with llmClient from @redwood/sdk-js. Telemetry shows no events for `agent.run`.
sofia: Hmm, is this the modular plugin that wires LlamaIndex as a chain? We had a change in SDK parity last week.
mike: I reproduced. Also saw auth 401s on quick successive calls until the SDK backoff kicks in. Log snippet: `ERR: 401 unauthorized - token expired` then `sdk: retrying in 1200ms` repeated.
emma: Minimal repro attached in the starter: pages/api/agent.ts uses `new RedwoodClient({ key: process.env.RW_KEY })` then `agent.run(...)`. Works in Python sample but JS SDK seems to skip instrumentation.
raj: Quick diff: JS SDK's agent wrapper doesn't call telemetry.trackEvent before calling model.generate in the modular agent path. I can open a PR.
sofia: Can we confirm this is parity issue vs real user error? Might be missing middleware hook in starter.
mike: I commented in the starter code — the helper that wires the plugin isn't passing `telemetryContext`. Minimal fix is adding `agent.options.telemetryContext = getTelemetryCtx(req)` but that's hacky.
emma: Also auth: tokens are rotated by the dev console plugin; our runtime-level fetch wrapper sometimes doesn't propagate the refreshed token to the agent-level LLM instance. Result: first call after rotation 401, then retries.
raj: Sounds like two separate bugs: telemetry hookup and token propagation. I can take telemetry PR. Who will own token propagation?
sofia: I can pick token propagation — probably in the SDK fetch adapter. I'll try to add tests. We need a small e2e harness that runs the starter and asserts a telemetry event and no 401 on rotation.
ci-bot: created issue #DE-487: "modular-agent starter: telemetry not firing & auth token not propagated on rotation" assigned to @raj @sofia.
mike: Proposed temporary workaround for users: set a middleware in Next API that re-creates the LLM client per-request using the current token env value. Not ideal but avoids stale token.
emma: That workaround is ok for now. Also adding a note in the starter README about auth rotation and linking the issue.
raj: PR opened: PR #1284 — telemetry hook added to modular-agent adapter. Added unit test to assert telemetry.trackEvent called.
sofia: WIP branch for token propagation, adding integration test using the eval harness to simulate token rotation signal. I'll post updates.
mike: Thx. Also logging suggestion: include `sdk.clientId` in telemetry to tie starter sessions to user flows (opt-in).
emma: Agreed. For transparency, add opt-in env var RW_TELEMETRY_OPT_IN. We'll document in the starter.
sofia: I'll update the eval harness to run on GH actions matrix (node 18/20) so parity failures pop earlier.
raj: Once PR merges, we should cherry-pick into the existing release branch and patch the starter template used by the quickstart.
emma: Thanks team. tagging @devex to triage release notes.
mike: :thumbsup:
sofia: Leaving notes in the issue with repro steps and a tiny script: ```bash
# repro token rotation 401
export RW_KEY=old
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/rotate-token -d '{}'
# then immediate call to agent endpoint
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/agent -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
emma: Perfect. Closing loop once both PRs are merged.
